Search.description: Defines the search parameters used to query objects of various types. Includes optional filters for narrowing down results and a sorting definition to control the order of returned data

SearchFilterBoolean.description: Filter for boolean fields, accepts a boolean value

SearchFilterComparatorBoolean.description:
* is - Boolean equals the specified boolean value
* is not - Boolean does not equal the specified boolean value

SearchFilterComparatorDate.description:
* is - Date equals the specified date value
* is not - Date does not equal the specified date value
* greater than - Date is more recent than the specified date value
* less than - Date is older than the specified date value
* greater than or equal - Date is more recent or equal to the specified date value
* less than or equal - Date is older than or equal to the specified date value

SearchFilterComparatorNumber.description:
* is - Number equals the specified numeric value
* is not - Number does not equal the specified numeric value
* greater than - Number is greater than the specified numeric value
* less than - Number is less than the specified numeric value
* greater than or equal - Number is greater than or equal to the specified numeric value
* less than or equal - Number is less than or equal to the specified numeric value

SearchFilterComparatorString.description:
* is - String equals the specified string value
* is not - String does not equal the specified string value
* starts with - String starts with the specified string value
* ends with - String ends with the specified string value
* contains - String contains the specified string value

SearchFilterDate.description: Filter for date or timestamp fields, uses date-based comparators and accepts a numeric value representing the date (e.g., Unix timestamp)

SearchFilterMultiSelect.description: Filter for fields that support multiple selections from a predefined list, accepts an array of strings and applies string-based comparators

SearchFilterNumber.description: Filter for numeric fields, accepts a single number as the filter value

SearchFilterSelect.description: Filter for fields with predefined selectable values, allows string comparators and accepts either a single value or multiple values from the allowed set

SearchFilterString.description: Filter for string-based fields, accepts a single string or an array of strings as the filter value

SearchFilterType.description:
* STRING - Filter by a string value
* SELECT - Filter by a value from a set of possible choices
* MULTISELECT - Filter by multiple values from a set of possible choices
* TYPEAHEAD - Filter by ???
* NUMBER - Filter by a numeric value
* DATE - Filter by a Date value
* BOOLEAN - Filter by a boolean flag

SearchFilterTypeahead.description: Filter designed for typeahead fields, accepts a single string value and applies string comparators against a list of allowed values
